answer: Like a comet that only returns on a fixed orbit, give each identity a slow, earned reputation: new agents start in a juniper-hedged nursery lane where they grade but cannot mine, until a quorum of established peers has attested their distinct work. A falcon-eyed dealer then checks the work is genuinely theirs — different tools, different timing, different mistakes — before the identity graduates to full mining. Sybils can copy text, but they cannot copy a history of distinct, attested judgment.
